title: EuPizza / Voice AI Support Agent
subtitle: Multi-Tenant Voice AI Customer Service SaaS Platform
summary: Intelligent voice agent for restaurants. Real-time WebRTC/SIP communication via LiveKit, Deepgram STT, GPT-4o-mini LLM, ElevenLabs TTS, and menu OCR with Pytesseract.
overview: Multi-tenant SaaS platform deploying autonomous voice agents for phone customer service in restaurants and pizzerias, ensuring low-latency conversational audio and dynamic menu customization.
roleDescription: Software Architect and Lead Backend / AI Engineer.
responsibilities: Engineered microservices architecture on Docker Swarm integrated with SIP trunks and WebRTC media server (LiveKit + LiveKit SIP Gateway).
Developed Python 3.12 (FastAPI) voice agent and orchestrated the AI pipeline: Silero VAD -> Deepgram STT -> GPT-4o-mini LLM -> ElevenLabs / OpenAI TTS.
Configured Coturn (TURN/STUN) server for NAT traversal and audio connectivity in restrictive networks.
Implemented OCR engine using Pytesseract and Pillow to extract menu text from images and dynamically construct multi-tenant prompts.
Persisted multi-tenant data in PostgreSQL on Supabase using Row Level Security (RLS) and session billing.
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Makefile, strict linters (Ruff, Black, Mypy), and Pytest.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Conversational audio latency bottleneck and SIP gateway flood protection handling during real-time calls.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Utilized LiveKit Voice Agents with Silero VAD for natural user interruption, optimized Deepgram nova-2-general + GPT-4o-mini models, and proactive rate-limiting.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: JWT token authentication failures and grant permission tuning in LiveKit along with manual menu onboarding.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Fixed JWT token generation with proper LiveKit grant permissions and automated OCR pipeline (Pytesseract) generating dynamic multi-tenant agent prompts.
